_comment: Acceptance contract for brain/10-specs/e5-confirm-prompt-field-v2.md. The agent may ONLY flip 'passes'. Entries may never be added, removed, or reworded. Written 2026-09-19 (unattended run 2).

features.description: A sentence with {argument_name} placeholders is filled in from the call's arguments and shown above them.
Substitution is one regex over {[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,63}} and nothing else: no expression, filter, attribute access, index, loop or conditional is evaluated, and each is shown as literal text instead.
No jinja, str.format, render_template or safe_eval is reachable from this path, proved by a grep whose identical form hits run 1's code.
A database call written into the field stays literal text; rendering reads nothing beyond the template and the arguments, proved with database access patched to raise.
Every substituted value is wrapped in quotes and shown verbatim, with control and format characters (Cc, Cf, bidi overrides included) escaped rather than interpreted.
A value cannot open a line of its own and forge a second question.
A value cannot close the quotes that hold it, and a literal backslash is distinguishable from a real control character.
Nothing is ever silently truncated: a value over 200 characters, a missing argument, or a non-scalar argument abandons the whole sentence and falls back to the JSON dump.
A padded value cannot hide the rest of the author's sentence.
The exact arguments that will execute are shown beneath the sentence in every case, so a sentence that misdescribes the tool still shows the truth.
Rendering never raises, and a sentence that cannot be produced never stops the person being asked.
The first line uses the tool's human title when there is one and the slug when there is not, and a title cannot open a line of its own.
The code attribute confirm_prompt still wins when present, and upstream's TestAgentConfirmation stays green and unmodified.
Options are exactly [Approve, Deny], allow_other is unchanged, and only the exact answer Approve executes a tool with a sentence on it.
